As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll help lead the development and architecture of critical flight software and systems, reporting directly to the VP of Software, and collaborating with an impressive technical team of aerospace engineers.
cond_0497.responsibilities: Develop flight software for inflight computers and other critical spacecraft hardware. Collaborate with the Electrical and Hardware division to seamlessly integrate software solutions. Configure RTOS, Microprocesses, and Linux Kernels/Drivers. Design and execute full software test cases.
cond_0497.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in coding in C++ and Linux environments
Advanced knowledge of hardware datasheets and schematics
Deep knowledge of tools: Git, Make, and GNU tools
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or similar disciplines required; advanced degree strongly preferred
cond_0497.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, in cases where candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to women applicants in support of our gender balance commitment.
cond_0497.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.
